title: Kyber ibikhona eVivaTech
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
html:
Kyber eVivaTech 2026: Izinsuku ezine zemibukiso, ukunakwa ngabezindaba nezingxoxo ezijulile

I-VivaTech 2026 isiphelile, futhi ibingeyokukhunjulwa. Izinsuku ezine ezibe matasa kakhulu, ithimba leKyber belisenkundleni yomcimbi omkhulu kunayo yonke wezobuchwepheshe eYurophu, likhombisa ubuchwepheshe bethu bengqalasizinda esebenza ngesikhathi sangempela konjiniyela, abasunguli bamabhizinisi, abatshalimali nabaqambi abavela emhlabeni wonke.

Nakhu ukubuyekezwa okugcwele kwalokho okwenzekile, esikhulume nabo, nokuthi kungani lo mcimbi ubalulekile kithina.

Kungani iKyber ibikhona eVivaTech 2026

I-VivaTech yindawo lapho kwenzeka khona izingxoxo ezibalulekile. Amarobhothi, ama-drone, i-XR, abasizi bobuhlakani bokwenziwa, ingqalasizinda ezimele yona, amasistimu asebenza ngesikhathi sangempela: lezi azisezona izihloko zabambalwa. Zisenhliziyweni yalapho ubuchwepheshe bubhekise khona, futhi uhlelo lweshumi lweVivaTech, olugubha iminyaka eyishumi, lukubonise lokho ngendlela engakaze ibonwe.

KuKyber, ukuba khona bekuyisinyathelo esinengqondo. Sakha ingqalasizinda esebenza ngesikhathi sangempela enokubambezeleka okuncane ngokwedlulele, eyakhelwe inkathi yobuhlakani bokwenziwa obusebenza emhlabeni wenyama, ubuchwepheshe obuvumela amarobhothi, ama-drone, amasistimu e-XR nemishini ezisebenzelayo ukuthi alawulwe kude ngokuphendula cishe ngaso leso sikhathi. I-VivaTech yiyona ndawo abahlangana kuyo labo abadinga lobu buchwepheshe ukuze bahlole okuzayo.

Simise esitendini sabalingani nabangane bethu baseScaleway, eHholo 7.3, eSitendini 3F10, futhi sachitha isonto lonke sibonisa imibukiso ebukhoma elandelanayo ezivakashini ebezize ukuzobona iKyber isebenza.

UJean-Baptiste Kempf eVivaTech: esiteji, emoyeni nasezindabeni

Esiteji ne-Inria

UJean-Baptiste Kempf, umsunguli weKyber futhi ongomunye wonjiniyela abahamba phambili ngemuva kweVLC, wenze inkulumo esiteji seVivaTech enesihloko esithi “Kusuka Ekubhaleni Ikhodi Kuya Ekunikezeni Imiyalo”, ngokubambisana ne-Inria, isikhungo sikazwelonke saseFrance socwaningo kwezesayensi yedijithali nobuchwepheshe.

Inkulumo ibhekane nemibuzo emibili ephuthumayo kakhulu ebhekene nemboni yezobuchwepheshe namuhla:

Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa busho ukuthini emathimbeni onjiniyela? Njengoba amamodeli amakhulu olimi eseqala ukukwazi ukukhiqiza ikhodi esezingeni lokukhiqiza, iqhaza lonjiniyela lishintsha kakhulu. Ingabe izinhlangano zisaqasha onjiniyela ngendlela efanayo? Ingabe zisabaqasha nhlobo?

Kwenzekani emathuluzini nasengqalasizindeni esakhe phezu kwayo konke? Izinkundla zokwakha isofthiwe, izinqubo zokuthuthukisa, ingqalasizinda yefu: konke lokhu kucatshangwa kabusha njengoba indlela esakha ngayo isofthiwe ishintsha kusukela empandeni.

Le akuyona imibuzo yokucabangela nje. Kumsunguli onjengoJean-Baptiste, osechithe amashumi eminyaka akha ingqalasizinda ebalulekile yomthombo ovulekile, iyimibuzo ethinta impilo yangempela.

BFM Business, Tech & Co

NgoMsombuluko, mhla zingama-22 kuNhlangulana, uJean-Baptiste Kempf uhlanganyele noFrançois Sorel kuBFM Business ohlelweni lwansuku zonke iTech & Co, ehambisana noThomas Serval (CEO weBaracoda), uJean Schmitt (uMongameli weJolt Capital) noHugo Borensztein (umsunguli ohlanganyelwe noMongameli we-Omi).

Iphaneli ibuyekeze uhlelo lweshumi lweVivaTech: ukuvela kukaJeff Bezos okukhulunywe ngakho kakhulu kulo mbukiso, izinto ezibagqamele ngokwabo phakathi kwezinto ezintsha ezibukisiwe, kanye nekusasa elide lalo mcimbi obalulekile wezobuchwepheshe waseYurophu.

Buka kabusha kuBFM Business

BSMART 4Change

UJean-Baptiste Kempf uphinde wavela kuBSMART 4Change, okwandise nakakhulu ukuvela kweKyber ezindabeni phakathi nesonto lomcimbi.

Buka kabusha kuYouTube

TechCrunch

Indaba yeKyber idonse amehlo eTechCrunch, eshicilele indatshana ekhuluma ngoJean-Baptiste Kempf nobuchwepheshe abakhayo, ilandelela uhambo lwakhe kusukela kuVLC, isidlali samavidiyo samahhala esidume kakhulu emhlabeni, kuya engqalasizindeni esebenza ngesikhathi sangempela yamarobhothi namasistimu obuhlakani bokwenziwa obusebenza emhlabeni wenyama.

Funda indatshana yeTechCrunch: “Wenza isidlali sakho samavidiyo samahhala sasebenza kahle. Manje usenza okufanayo kumarobhothi.”

Izinsuku ezine zemibukiso nezingxoxo zebhizinisi

Ngaphandle kwezikhathi zabezindaba, isonto ligqame ngezingxoxo ebezenzeka enkundleni.

Sibonise imibukiso ebukhoma engaphezi kuzo zonke izinsuku ezine, sinika izivakashi ithuba lokuzibonela ngawabo lokho okungenziwa yisakhiwo seKyber esisebenza ngesikhathi sangempela: ividiyo, umsindo, idatha yezinzwa nemiyalo yokulawula, konke kuphathwa ngokubambezeleka okungaphansi kwamashumi ama-ms ezindaweni zefu, ezixubile nezisemaphethelweni enethiwekhi.

Izingxoxo bezithinta yonke imikhakha: abalingani abangaba khona behlola amathuba okuhlanganisa, amakhasimende afuna ukuqonda ukuthi iKyber ingena kanjani ezakhiweni zawo, abasunguli beqhathanisa amava, nonjiniyela bebuza imibuzo enzima yezobuchwepheshe. Leyo nhlanganisela, ubuningi nokwehluka kwayo, yikho okwenza iVivaTech ingafani nomunye umcimbi.

Iphinde yafika ngesikhathi esibalulekile kithina: iKyber isanda kumemezela umzuliswano wokuqala wokutshala imali ongu-$5 wezigidi zamadola, oholwa yiLightspeed, ilandelwa yiKima kanye ne-Ovni Capital. Lesi simemezelo sivuse intshisekelo kubadlali abafana ncamashi nalabo ebesithemba ukuhlangana nabo emcimbini.

Amazwi okubonga

Siyabonga ngokusuka enhliziyweni kubo bonke abeme esitendini ukuzoxoxa, ukuzama imibukiso yethu, noma ukubuza nje imibuzo. Ukubonga okukhethekile kuyaya kuScaleway ngokwamukela ithimba leKyber esitendini sabo zonke izinsuku ezine: abalingani abahle benza umehluko.

Sizobonana eVivaTech 2027

Uhlelo lweshumi lweVivaTech beluvuthile, lunezizwe zonke, futhi lugcwele amabhizinisi angempela. Size ukuzokhombisa esikwakhayo, sihlangane nabantu ababumba imboni, futhi sifakazele ukuthi ubuchwepheshe obujulile obenziwe eFrance busaphila kahle.

Umsebenzi ufeziwe.

Sizobuya. Sizobonana ngonyaka ozayo 💎

Ufuna ukwazi okwengeziwe ngeKyber? Vakashela ku-kyber.tech noma usithinte ku-contact@kyber.tech.

Izinkampani okukhulunywe ngazo kule ndatshana

Scaleway: Umhlinzeki wamasevisi efu waseFrance onikeza izixazululo zengqalasizinda ezimele yona neqhubekayo, kuhlanganise amandla okucubungula, ukugcina idatha namasevisi aphethwe.

Inria: Isikhungo sikazwelonke saseFrance socwaningo kwezesayensi yedijithali nobuchwepheshe, esigxile kwezezibalo, isayensi yamakhompyutha nokusetshenziswa kwazo.

BFM Business: Isiteshi sikamabonakude saseFrance esisebenza amahora angama-24 nsuku zonke, esizinikele ezindabeni zomnotho, zezimali nezobuchwepheshe.

BSMART: Isiteshi sikamabonakude saseFrance sezamabhizinisi nokuqamba izinto ezintsha, esibika ngezamabhizinisi amasha, ubuchwepheshe noguquko oluqhubekayo.

TechCrunch: Inkundla yabezindaba ehamba phambili emhlabeni ebika ngamabhizinisi amasha, ubuchwepheshe nezimali zokutshala emabhizinisini asafufusa.

Baracoda: Inkampani yobuchwepheshe bezinto ezixhumene nethiwekhi nobezempilo ethuthukisa amadivayisi axhumene nezixazululo ezihlakaniphile zezindawo zokusebenza nemboni yezempilo.

Jolt Capital: Isikhwama saseYurophu sokutshala imali yokukhula esigxile ezinkampanini zobuchwepheshe obujulile nobuchwepheshe obusebenzela amanye amabhizinisi.

Omi: Inkundla yamadivayisi agqokwayo asebenza ngobuhlakani bokwenziwa, enika inkumbulo yesikhathi sangempela, ukukhiqiza okwengeziwe nosizo lomuntu siqu lobuhlakani bokwenziwa.

Lightspeed: Inkampani yomhlaba wonke yokutshala imali emabhizinisini asafufusa, etshala emabhizinisini asezigabeni zokuqala nezokukhula emikhakheni yabathengi, yamabhizinisi neyobuchwepheshe obujulile.

Kima Ventures: Isikhwama sokutshala imali emabhizinisini asesesigabeni sokuqala esizinze eParis, esingesinye sabatshalimali bokuqala abakhuthele kakhulu eYurophu.

Ovni Capital: Isikhwama saseFrance sokutshala imali emabhizinisini asafufusa, esitshala emabhizinisini obuchwepheshe anesibindi achaza kabusha imikhakha yawo.
